reason: The text depicts Pharaoh consulting with his people (וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־ עַמּוֹ - 'And he said to his people') about dealing with the Israelites, saying 'Come, let us deal wisely with them' (הָבָה נִתְחַכְּמָה לוֹ). They subsequently work together to establish an oppressive system: task-masters (שָׂרֵי מִסִּים) are appointed to supervise forced labor, indicating coordinated action between the leadership and populace in executing this policy. This demonstrates clear collaboration between leaders and people in their collective actions.
